source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 8,200 employees.

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: Chief Executive Officer total annual compensation $ 242,122 Median Employee total annual compensation $ 235,416 Ratio of Chief Executive Officer to Median Employee total annual compensation 1 to 0.97

notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K; it excludes the approximately 13,000 third-party workers who handle most community support contacts. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used. Airbnb identified the median employee among all full-time, part-time and temporary employees at December 31, 2025, using annualized base salary and bonus target plus equity awarded in 2025. The CEO's 2025 total compensation ($242,122) was slightly above the median's.
